title: Finite-cover descent in the first factor of external tensor sections
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], $f:X\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ and $g:Y\to\operatorname{Spec} k$ schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $F,G$ module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. Let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be a finite open cover of $X$. Assume the canonical external tensor map [def-sc-scalar-global-sections-comparison] is bijective for each $(U_i,Y,F|_{U_i},G)$ and each $(U_i\cap U_j,Y,F|_{U_i\cap U_j},G)$ with the induced structure maps. Then the external tensor map for $(X,Y,F,G)$ is bijective. No affineness, quasi-coherence or compactness is assumed.

proof.text: Apply the first-factor external section restriction comparison to obtain a presheaf morphism c, its top normalization and the local source and target isomorphisms. Each local canonical bijectivity hypothesis makes c at that chart or overlap an isomorphism: convert bijectivity to IsIso in ModuleCat, use the component square, and cancel the target section isomorphism.

Use TopCat.Presheaf.IsSheaf.isSheafPairwiseIntersections for the scalar section sheaf of F. With N=Gamma(Y,G), Mathlib.RingTheory.Flat.CategoryTheory supplies PreservesFiniteLimits (tensorRight N) over the field. The finite Pairwise category (using Fintype.ofFinite) therefore gives a limit cone for the tensor presheaf. The external section presheaf is the continuous pushforward along pr_1 of a scalar section sheaf, so it has the same pairwise limit property by TopCat.Sheaf.pushforward_sheaf_of_sheaf. Whisker c with the pairwise diagram. Its components are isomorphisms by the chart and overlap hypotheses; NatIso.isIso_of_isIso_app turns it into an isomorphism of diagrams. The two limit cones have isomorphic cone points by IsLimit.conePointsIsoOfNatIso. IsLimit.hom_ext and naturality of c identify this cone-point isomorphism with c at iSup U. Rewrite hcover, use the top normalization and convert IsIso back to Function.Bijective. Finite empty diagrams are included without Nonempty assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem externalGlobalSectionsTensor_bijective_of_finite_cover_left
    (k : Type w) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{w})
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    {ι : Type w} [Finite ι] (U : ι → X.Opens) (hcover : iSup U = ⊤)
    (hU : ∀ i, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor ((U i).ι ≫ f) g (F.restrict (U i).ι) G))
    (hUU : ∀ i j, Function.Bijective
      (externalGlobalSectionsTensor ((U i ⊓ U j).ι ≫ f) g
        (F.restrict (U i ⊓ U j).ι) G)) :
    Function.Bijective (externalGlobalSectionsTensor f g F G)
